system.description:
Opal's most aggressive duelling school: attack as defence, momentum as armour.

  • Committed Blade: Relentless Assault starts from the second hit as normal, but its bonus is +2d4 instead of +1d4.
    • 9th level: +3d4.
  • Noble Rivalry: Advantage on Intimidation checks and on checks involving duelling culture and noble rivalries.

features.name: Committed Blade

activities.name: Relentless Assault (2d4)
activities.text: Relentless Assault's bonus is +2d4 instead of +1d4, from the second hit against the same target as normal.

rules.when: each Relentless Assault hit (on top of its +1d4: +2d4 in total, +3d4 from 9th)
